display.purpose: The wordmark and hero moments; 40/44 base, scaled up to 58/64 on the onboarding welcome. Never bolded — the serif carries the weight.

displayItalic.purpose: The 'Check' half of the wordmark and the lowercase 'fitcheck' stamp on share cards; 40/44 base.

title.purpose: Screen titles, section titles, empty-state headlines, and stat numbers; 28/32.

body.purpose: Prose, descriptions, button labels (600 inside buttons); 16/23.

caption.purpose: Footnotes, statuses, chip and small-button labels; 13/18.

micro.purpose: Overlines, step counters, tab labels, dates, watermarks; 11/14. The editorial whisper above every serif title.

spacing.note: A 4pt rhythm; screen gutters are l (16), section gaps xl (24), grid-cell gaps xs (4).

radius.note: Cards and camera frames are l; images and inputs m; thumbnails s; every button, chip, dot, and progress bar is pill.

motion.name: press-spring
motion.purpose: Every touchable via PressableScale, paired with a light haptic tick; the app's default touch feel.

motion.name: enter-fade
motion.value: FadeInDown 300ms, staggered 60ms per sibling (up to 550ms on the welcome collage)
motion.purpose: Screen sections and list items entering; nothing slides sideways.

motion.name: prompt-crossfade
motion.purpose: Selfie-step prompt text swaps; the keyed remount does the crossfade.

motion.name: image-fade
motion.purpose: Every image resolves with a soft fade over a surfaceAlt placeholder — never a pop.

motion.name: skeleton-breathe
motion.purpose: Skeleton blocks while renders and images load.

motion.name: avatar-pulse
motion.value: scale 1 to 1.04, 900ms each way, inOut ease, infinite
motion.purpose: The portrait ring while the avatar builds.

motion.name: build-progress
motion.purpose: The lime avatar-build bar — a real bar with a real end, not an indeterminate loop.

haptics.name: capture
haptics.purpose: A selfie lands in the tray.

haptics.name: toggle
haptics.purpose: Layout chips and other selection switches.

haptics.name: celebrate
haptics.purpose: Avatar ready, card saved to photos, demo avatar chosen.

haptics.name: guard
haptics.purpose: Every haptic call is web-guarded and swallows failures.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The ink pill — the one main action per screen. Heights 56/48/38 (l/m/s); label is the ground color at weight 600; disabled fades to 40%.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ink, #131313); color: var(--color-bg, #F6F4EF); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Acid lime with ink text — spent rarely: the shutter ring, GitHub star, celebration-tier actions. Same pill geometry as primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent, #D4F53C); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #131313); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent pill with a strong-hairline outline; the calm second action ('Save to photos', 'Use the demo avatar').
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, rgba(19, 19, 19, 0.28)); border-radius: 999px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: A bare ink label for tertiary moves ('Back', 'Pick from library instead'); no border, no fill, still a full-height touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-text:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Destructive Text Button
components.description: The text button in Brick for irreversible acts ('Delete everything on this phone'); always followed by a native confirm dialog, never a bare tap.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--color-danger, #C2452D); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A 36pt outline pill toggle (share layouts, filters); selection inverts it to solid ink with ground text and fires a selection haptic.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, rgba(19, 19, 19, 0.28)); border-radius: 999px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--color-ink, #131313); color: var(--color-bg, #F6F4EF); border-color: var(--color-ink, #131313); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Paper-white surface, radius 24, one ink hairline, 16px padding, overflow hidden. Flat — no card in the app carries a shadow.
components.html: FitCheck is MIT-licensed. Read the code, file an issue, or star it.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(19, 19, 19, 0.12)); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 23px; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: One of three equal cards on the You tab: the number set in the serif title voice, a micro label whispered beneath, everything centered.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: var(--color-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(19, 19, 19, 0.12)); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; min-width: 104px; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; line-height: 32px; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); } .ds-stat-label { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 14px; letter-spacing: 1.4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted, #6E6A63); }

components.name: Screen
components.description: Every route's scaffold: ivory ground, safe-area top inset (off under modals), 16px gutters, bottom inset + 32px, optional ScrollView with taps persisting through the keyboard.
components.css: .ds-screen { background: var(--color-bg, #F6F4EF); padding: 16px; min-height: 120px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-screen-hint { color: var(--color-muted, #6E6A63); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: AppText
components.description: The only text primitive: seven variants (display, displayItalic, title, heading, body, caption, micro), muted flag, explicit color override. Nothing renders a raw Text.
components.html: Step 2 of 5Chin up a littleBody copy stays in the system face.
components.css: .ds-type { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-type-micro { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 14px; letter-spacing: 1.4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted, #6E6A63); } .ds-type-title { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; line-height: 32px; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); } .ds-type-body { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 23px; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); }

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: The wait state: a shimmer-token block (radius 10, pill when round) breathing opacity 0.5 to 1 over 700ms while renders and images load.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { width: 160px; height: 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-shimmer, rgba(19, 19, 19, 0.06)); animation: ds-breathe 0.7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } @keyframes ds-breathe { from { opacity: 0.5; } to { opacity: 1; } }

components.name: SectionHeader
components.description: A micro overline whispering above a serif title, with an optional trailing action; the settings screens swap the serif title for a hairline divider + overline alone.
components.css: .ds-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-section-overline { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 14px; letter-spacing: 1.4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted, #6E6A63); } .ds-section-title { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; line-height: 32px; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); }

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Centered serif title, muted body capped at 280pt, one primary action. Copy explains what happened and what to do next, in one calm breath.
components.html: Can't find that fitRender it again and it'll be right here.
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 48px 16px; } .ds-empty-title { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; line-height: 32px; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); text-align: center; } .ds-empty-body { max-width: 280px; text-align: center; color: var(--color-muted, #6E6A63); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 23px; }

components.name: PressableScale
components.description: The touch primitive under every button, chip, card, and tab: springs to 0.97 on press (damping 20, stiffness 400) with a light haptic tick. The pressed state is never invisible.
components.css: .ds-pressable { background: var(--color-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(19, 19, 19, 0.12)); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } .ds-pressable:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: EditorialTabBar
components.description: Text-only tabs on the ground color over a top hairline: micro-caps labels, no icons, a 16x3 lime tick under the active tab. Padding lives on the pressables so the whole bar height stays a 44pt-plus target.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; background: var(--color-bg, #F6F4EF); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(19, 19, 19, 0.12)); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 0; background: transparent; border: none; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.4px; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted, #6E6A63); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--color-ink, #131313); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab-tick { width: 16px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-accent, #D4F53C); } .ds-tab-tick-off { background: transparent; }

narrative.overview:
FitCheck reads like an editorial fashion spread that happens to be an app: ivory paper (#F6F4EF), ink type (#131313), and exactly one acid accent (#D4F53C) spent like a stylist spends a statement piece. Instrument Serif is the display voice — the FitCheck wordmark (roman 'Fit', italic 'Check'), screen titles, empty-state headlines, and the stat numbers on the You tab — while everything functional sits in the system sans. Surfaces are flat paper: white cards seated with ink hairlines, never shadows, and the dark scheme is the same magazine printed on night stock (#111110 ground, warm off-white ink) rather than an inverted afterthought — every color routes through useTheme() tokens so both schemes are first-class.

The acid lime is the garment of the outfit: it marks the active tab tick, the shutter ring, the avatar-build progress bar, the portrait ring, and the current step dot — identity and progress, never decoration and never large text. Touch is tactile everywhere: every tappable springs to 0.97 with a light haptic tick, commits (capturing a selfie, saving a card, finishing the avatar) get a heavier or success haptic, and every haptic call is guarded for web and swallows failures. Images always fade in over a pressed-ivory placeholder; waits breathe as skeletons or a real progress bar with a real end. Copy is a friend who knows clothes: sentence case, contractions, plain verbs ('Put it on me', 'That's enough'), honest about the demo, and never 'seamless', 'effortless', or 'elevate'.
keyCharacteristics: One accent: acid lime appears only as identity and progress marks (tab tick, shutter, build bar, avatar ring, step dot) — never as decoration, borders, or text color.
Serif voice: Instrument Serif for display and title moments only; body, buttons, and navigation stay in the system sans.
Micro overlines: 11pt uppercase +1.4 tracking labels whisper above serif titles and section dividers — the editorial signature.
Flat paper: hairline ink borders seat every surface; no card, button, or bar carries a shadow.
Tactile by default: spring-scale 0.97 pressed states and haptics on every touch, heavier on commit actions, all web-guarded.
Both schemes are real: every color is a useTheme() token; dark is warm night stock, not inverted light.
A 4pt rhythm: spacing 4/8/12/16/24/32/48, gutters 16, section gaps 24, grid-cell gaps 4.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime means 'you' and 'progress' — the active tab, the shutter, the build bar, the avatar ring, the current step. It never fills large areas, never colors text, and never appears twice in one view for two different reasons. Everything else is ink on ivory.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: No hardcoded colors, ever. Every color is read from useTheme() so light and dark are both right; translucent needs use the border, borderStrong, overlay, and shimmer tokens rather than ad-hoc rgba.

rules.name: The Serif Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is for what a magazine would set in display: the wordmark, screen and section titles, empty-state headlines, stat numbers, the share-card stamp. It never sets body copy, buttons, captions, or navigation.

rules.name: The Overline Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is micro overline, then serif title, then sans body. Steps, dates, tab labels, and section labels are always micro: 11pt, uppercase, +1.4 tracking, usually muted.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a hairline, not a shadow. Cards, inputs, tab bars, and share chrome are seated with border or borderStrong lines on flat surfaces; focus is shown by the hairline turning ink.

rules.name: The Committed-Touch Rule
rules.body: Every tap target is at least 44pt, every pressed state is visible (spring scale 0.97), and commit actions carry a haptic: light tick on press, medium on capture, selection on toggles, success on completion — always Platform.OS !== 'web' guarded with .catch(() => {}).

rules.name: The Honest-Wait Rule
rules.body: Images fade in over a surfaceAlt placeholder or Skeleton; the avatar build is a determinate lime bar with rotating status lines and a real end. Copy about waits and the demo tells the truth ('our cost, not yours', 'Demo mode renders a lookalike').

dos: Do write copy like a friend who knows clothes: sentence case, contractions, concrete verbs ('Put it on me', 'Redo my avatar', 'That's enough'), and errors as one calm sentence with a way forward ('Couldn't save that one. Give it another go.').
Do give every image a placeholder state — surfaceAlt behind expo-image with contentFit and a 200ms transition, recyclingKey in lists, Skeleton for unresolved layouts.
Do stagger entrances with FadeInDown at 300ms and roughly 60ms between siblings; crossfade text swaps by re-keying a FadeIn view.
Do keep destructive flows two-step: a Brick-colored text button, then a native confirm whose cancel is 'Never mind' and whose confirm names the act ('Delete it').
Do respect the 4pt grid: gutters 16, section gaps 24, card padding 16, grid-cell gaps 4 — and pill-radius every button, chip, and progress bar.
Do keep the share card story-ready: no app furniture, the italic 'fitcheck' stamp, an 'Aug 26'-style micro date, and the 'made with FitCheck' watermark at 35% opacity bottom-right.
donts: Don't hardcode a color, and don't design a screen that only works in one scheme.
Don't use marketing words — 'seamless', 'effortless', 'elevate' — anywhere, and allow at most one celebration exclamation in the entire app; errors and empty states never exclaim.
Don't put shadows on surfaces, icons in the tab bar, or the serif in body copy or buttons.
Don't spend lime on decoration, large fills, borders, or text — and never introduce a second accent hue.
Don't ship a tap target under 44pt, an invisible pressed state, or an unguarded haptic call.
Don't fake progress: no indeterminate loops where a determinate bar is possible, and no dishonest copy about what the demo does or what data leaves the phone (none does).
